size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)

machine.type: ground heat exchanger manifold skid per the node design block (design_survey_locked, ST-ORC-01): DN32 HDPE flow/return header runs on the skid, two bore-pair tie-in stubs to below grade (interface indication), the circulation-pump envelope (circ_pump_W 125.7, node) and the glycol fill pot; the hold-down/guard frame pins the registry box

bore_field.note: the boreholes are drilled subsurface works - not shop fabrication; the tie-in stubs are the interface indication, the depth/spacing are node facts named, not drawn to depth (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

a_hx_area.basis: pipe length 2 bores x 2 legs x 45 m + 6 m header = 186 m of DN32 (OD 42.4) = 24.8 m2 wetted loop area, from the model skid plus the node-quoted buried run; NOT called a calculated duty - the duty sheet states no mass throughput; q_per_m 35 W/m and Q_ceiling 3.0 kW th are the node's survey-locked class figures

machine.purchased: circulation pump envelope (125.7 W, node design circ_pump_W) - purchased per plan rule 6
machine.guard: four-post hold-down/guard frame pins the registry box (X-PAR-04); 8 slab anchors (fasteners.csv)
machine.material: HDPE DR-11 U-tubes, 1 in bore + horizontal runs; borehole grout thermal (node material); skid frame painted A500
machine.study_dims: skid header stations, pump envelope and fill pot are study values (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

N1.note: drain flush at the envelope bottom; 50 datum is the schedule placeholder

N2.note: vent flush at the envelope top; schedule datum 800 mm is the box top

N3.note: atmospheric hose joint at the envelope face (duty section 4; bore not calculated, hose, atmospheric); the loop tie to GEO_HP (the S43 class edge)

nozzle_idiom: atmospheric hose barbs flush at the envelope faces (duty section 4: atmospheric joints are hose; DN copied from the edge, not recalculated; rows read 'Bore not calculated. Rating hose, atmospheric'); N3 geothermal loop fluid out on +Y at z 600 (the loop tie to GEO_HP); drain flush at the envelope bottom (50 datum); vent flush at the envelope top (800 datum is the box top); no flange (W4 110 % rule); the schedule rating column carried verbatim as text
